text: Government-sponsored organizational experimentation that enables new business models and new organizational structures is desirable and may be one of the few ways to facilitate the needed corporate governance reform.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Blockchain Solutions for Agency Problems in Corporate Governance (2019). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3373393
